decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb, Grief, and Brainstorm, and then bring them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Harvester of Misery early in the game, taking advantage of the combo potential of the Reanimator archetype to secure a quick victory.

This UWx Control deck relies on a combination of counterspells, removal, and disruptive spells like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to control the game and slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes cards like Back to Basics to disrupt mana bases, while leveraging powerful card selection and card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder. By controlling the board and denying the opponent resources, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent, eventually grinding out a win through card advantage and powerful threats like The wandering Emperor and Supreme Verdict.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to maintain a strong defense while setting up powerful plays with cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Up the Beanstalk. It also includes versatile cards like Leyline Binding and Dress Down to handle a variety of threats. The inclusion of additional lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary provides additional utility and flexibility in gameplay.

This Bant Control deck focuses on utilizing a high number of control spells and card draw to control the game's pace and outvalue the opponent. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw engines like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while consistently drawing into threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and The Wandering Emperor. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds additional value and flexibility to the already versatile deck.

The deck revolves around assembling the Painter's Servant combo with either Grindstone or Phyrexian Dragon Engine to mill the opponent's library in one turn. It aims to generate mana quickly with cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to power out its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent with cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster to pressure the opponent and close out games quickly. The main focus is on efficiently executing the combo to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back into play using cards like Entomb, Animate Dead, and Reanimate. By utilizing powerful reanimation spells in combination with efficient discard outlets, the deck aims to cheat expensive creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play ahead of schedule, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The key goal is to assemble the combo pieces necessary to reanimate game-ending threats and establish a dominant board presence early on in the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a big swing with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Dauthi Voidwalker to protect the combo pieces and control elements like Force of Will and Daze to counter opponent's threats. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their plans with counterspells and removal, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will, while also utilizing efficient card draw with Brainstorm and Ponder. Additionally, the deck includes creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Brazen Borrower for additional threats and flexibility in gameplay.

The key strategy of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Grist, the Hunger Tide using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Entomb. Once key creatures are in the graveyard, the player can then use cards like Reanimate and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to bring them back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats early in the game. The deck aims to combo off and reanimate big threats to dominate the board and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cheat out powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst. The deck aims to apply pressure early on, disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation. Additionally, the inclusion of Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes provides a versatile and resilient threat that can further complement the aggro strategy. The deck's consistency is enhanced by the mana base and efficient mana acceleration tools like Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide.

The main idea of this deck is to use control elements to manipulate the game in your favor, utilizing powerful control spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck also contains cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Endurance to provide additional value and protection. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure the deck can consistently cast its spells, while cards like Leyline Binding and Triumph of Saint Katherine help further control the game and set up for a win condition.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure to the opponent through aggressive creatures and efficient spells. By utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong offensive presence. With a focus on tempo and disruption, the deck seeks to maintain momentum and outpace the opponent in order to secure a swift victory.

This deck revolves around the powerful combo of using Doomsday to stack our deck with a winning sequence of cards, followed by Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck includes efficient card selection and card advantage tools like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Personal Tutor to set up the combo quickly. It also includes various disruption spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo or disrupt our opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, aiming to win the game as quickly as possible.

This Dragon Stompy deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void while applying early pressure with aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Stingerback Terror. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fury to close out games quickly. By utilizing fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, this deck aims to establish a dominant board presence early on and prevent the opponent from casting their spells effectively. The key concept is using disruptive elements and aggressive creatures to control the game and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on using control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent, while also utilizing the powerful synergy between Knight of the Reliquary, Life from the Loam, and Crop Rotation to search for key lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a game-winning Marit Lage token. The deck also has access to powerful utility lands like Maze of Ith and Bojuka Bog, and can generate card advantage with cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Once Upon a Time. This deck aims to control the game and out value the opponent through strategic land plays and efficient removal.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 indestructible flying Marit Lage token. This combo can be supported with cards like Crop Rotation, Sylvan Scrying, and Lotus Petal to search for the necessary pieces and generate mana. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Pithing Needle to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect the combo. Additionally, utility lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Bojuka Bog provide additional value and options for the player.
